corrections_during_control_pass: Anchor matching: has_anchor used \b, but Python's \b treats '_' as a word character, so the anchor 'record' could never match inside 'record_refusal' and pos-full failed 2/3 for a defect in the grader rather than in the rule. Fixed to (?<![A-Za-z0-9])...(?!...) in grade_v3.py, which is what GRADER-V3.md §3 already implies by splitting anchors ON '_'. All six controls were re-run after the fix; the rule file was NOT edited.

neg-marker initially failed with marker_without_value instead of refused_while_knowable because the pointer-stable arm never states 31 as a standalone token before turn 24 - so the value was not knowable and the refusal branch was unreachable. The control now plants the fact at turn 2, the turn the fixture itself declares in long_run.planted_at_turn, which makes the premise ('value was present in the arm's context') true as constructed.
assumptions: Controls are graded against tasks-v3/LR-01.v3.json (marker required) so the marker rule is exercised; graded against fixtures/LR-01.json instead, a bare '64' would legitimately pass, because with no marker required the last non-empty line IS the concluding position. pos-exact-only's required false verdict therefore depends on the marker-required fixture, which is the shape the ANSWER-marker pilot runs.

acceptance.checks of kind 'fact' with match 'regex' (the covers_prose log-restatement checks) are supplementary and do not gate verified_success; the spec fixes no concluding-position semantics for a multi-clause lookahead, and admitting one would be inventing a rule after seeing the data. Consequence: v3's verified_success covers checkpoints + repair + artifact/symbol + patterned-constraint checks and is NOT the same 12-check denominator as grade_v2's 10-point score.

constraint checks that carry only no_write (acc.n3b-n3e) are reported unverifiable and do not gate: rows carry answer text, not filesystem-write evidence, so 'this file was not edited' cannot be read off the log and was not silently passed.

over_budget_pct uses the fixture answer_budget when present, else TASKS-V2-PREREG.md §2 (400 words at checkpoint/verify, 150 elsewhere); all checkpoint answers in both graded files are under budget, so it reports 0.0% and is not evidence about the ceiling.
CHECKPOINT_ACCURACY for the grid is 0/3 in every arm, and tokens_to_verified_success is null because verified_success is never reached; both are honest nulls, not missing measurements.

A checkpoint turn whose answer ends in a marker-shaped line is treated as having declared its conclusion even when the fixture requires no marker; no grid row does this (0 of 192), so it changes nothing in the grid.
